fusions.name: Lap What Was Opened
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions. A bite that deals 8 damage, uses up one of those afflictions and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Out of the Eaves
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stingers at once, in a spread out to 7 tiles. Each one deals 10 damage and is always a critical hit, with a 50% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Roost Empties at Dusk
fusions.desc: Sends a swarm for 12 seconds. Every second it stings an enemy within 4 tiles and deals 3 damage. Each kill made while it flies restores 2 health to you.

fusions.name: Drinks at the Wound
fusions.desc: When you put a condition on an enemy, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
